extraction.Name: Benjamin Drappeau
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded March 29, 1917, by the Volz Abstract Company. The receipt for patent was signed by the allottee but not dated.
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged to W. H. Tackett for $2000 on March 1, 1919; previously mortgaged to Tackett for $500 on February 26, 1918; conveyed by deed to Ella McHenry on July 14, 1919 for $1.00 and other valuable consideration, subject to the $2000 mortgage
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612769 issued; Northwest quarter section 35, township 99, north of range 74; Benjamin Drappeau being one of the family (Sullys); a Lis pendens was filed in 1913 by Joe Kirby against the land, probably owing to a lawsuit the Sullys instituted against the United States in order to obtain their allotments.
